summary: Iteration 67 — Planning logic change: only spot_you_attendance (status=going) sessions appear in planning. 22/22 backend tests pass. All frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: Prochain événement time always shows '00:00' for all SpotYous (both recurring and single-date). Root cause: next_session_date from API is a date-only string (YYYY-MM-DD), and new Date('2026-03-11').toLocaleTimeString() = '00:00' (midnight). For recurring SpotYous, the time should be extracted from event_schedule; for single-date, from event_date.
ui_bugs.priority: LOW (doesn't affect planning logic, just display on spot-me page)

action_items: OPTIONAL FIX: spot-me.tsx formatNextDate() should extract time from event_schedule (for recurring) or event_date (for single-date) instead of relying on next_session_date which is date-only. Example fix: for recurring, iterate event_schedule.schedule[next_weekday] to get start time.
critical_code_review_comments: Planning logic correctly uses spot_you_attendance JOIN instead of tag_point_participants — new behavior confirmed working.
get_next_session_date returns date-only (not datetime), so spot-me.tsx formatNextDate() always shows 00:00 for time. Minor cosmetic issue.

going_spot_you auto-joins community (adds to spot_you_participants) but not_going_spot_you only removes attendance, NOT membership — this is intentional behavior (per feature: only attendance affects planning).
Backend deduplication logic (seen set) in get_planning_events is correct and prevents duplicate entries.
Bookings fallback (scheduled_at → slot_date+start_time) working correctly for all tested bookings.
seed_data_creation: Test left user_demo001 as 'going' to pt_demo014 (HIIT morning - Sceaux) from spot-me page Je participe test. Original state: going to pt_demo012 + pt_demo013.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Planning logic fully verified in iteration 67. Key: only spot_you_attendance with status=going appears in planning (not member-join). Backend 22/22 pass. Frontend: planning shows 2+1 SpotYou events correctly. SpotMe badge (green) for owner's own spots. Filter buttons (Tout/Événements/Réservations) work. Minor: spot-me.tsx shows '00:00' for event times (pre-existing display bug, not related to planning change).
